rationale: The proposed topology improves noise performance by replacing the resistive feedback (Rf) with a series inductor (Lfb) to form a narrowband inductive feedback network, which enhances input matching and reduces noise figure by leveraging the inductor’s frequency-dependent reactance to cancel input capacitance and improve gain at 1.575 GHz. This modification directly targets the most negative margin (nf_db = -1.408), which is the binding constraint, while preserving the existing gain and power efficiency. The inductor also aids in stabilizing the amplifier by increasing input impedance roll-off, indirectly improving S11 and S21 margins. The topology remains within device budget and process constraints.
